name: Section Collection – Add Ready-made Sections to Design Modern Websites
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Section Collection helps you build pages quickly using a growing library of Gutenberg sections, prebuilt sections, and ready-made sections for the WordPress block editor. Each section is professionally designed, easy to customize, and fully responsive. Whether you’re creating landing pages, business sites, portfolios, or service pages, you can insert complete page sections in one click and adjust them to fit your design.

The plugin works entirely inside the block editor, offering a clean and efficient workflow for users who prefer native Gutenberg blocks over heavy page builders.

Key Features

  • One-Click Page Sections: Insert complete section blocks and prebuilt layouts instantly. No coding required.
  • Multiple Stylish Designs: Switch between different Gutenberg layout blocks and styles to match your website.
  • Built for Faster Editing: Work efficiently with one-click sections, layout switching, and intuitive settings.
  • Fully Responsive: All sections are built as responsive page sections that look great on all devices.
  • Easy Customization: Tweak colors, spacing, typography, and other options with customizable section blocks.
  • Native Gutenberg Integration: Designed specifically for the block editor, making it a lightweight page builder alternative.

Included Sections & Layouts

Section Collection includes a variety of commonly used page building blocks and Gutenberg design blocks, such as:

  • Testimonials Section – Live Demo | Demo Video
  • Timeline Section – Live Demo | Demo Video
  • Ticker Section – Live Demo | Demo Video
  • About Us Section – Live Demo | Demo Video
  • Team Section – Live Demo | Demo Video

  • Brand Sponsor Section – Live Demo | Demo Video
  • Slider Section – Live Demo | Demo Video
  • Mission And Vision – Live Demo | Demo Video
  • Masonry Image Carousel – Live Demo | Demo Video
  • Multi Tab Timeline Section – Live Demo | Demo Video
  • Image Comparison Section – Live Demo | Demo Video
  • Video Showcase Section – Live Demo | Demo Video

This collection works as a simple WordPress section block library, helping you add reusable structures to any layout.

How to Use Section Collection – Step-by-Step Guide

Getting started with Section Collection is quick and easy!

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open the page or post in WordPress Block Editor.
  3. Look for the SECTION COLLECTION category.
  4. Add any ready-made sections you need.
  5. Customize the settings from the right-side options panel.
  6. Hit the Publish button.

Enjoy readymade beautiful website sections!

Why Use Section Collection?

  • Speeds up page creation using prebuilt sections and ready layouts
  • Keeps your site lightweight with the native Gutenberg block
  • Helps you build consistent, professional website sections
  • Works well for agencies, bloggers, businesses, and portfolio sites
  • Provides an organized website section library for quick reuse

sections.installation:
From Gutenberg Editor:

  1. Go to the WordPress Block/Gutenberg Editor
  2. Search For Section Collection
  3. Click on the Section Collection to add the block

Download & Upload:

  1. Download the Section Collection plugin (.zip file)
  2. In your admin area, go to the Plugins menu and click on Add New
  3. Click on Upload Plugin and choose the section-collection.zip file and click on Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin and Enjoy!

Manually:

  1. Download and upload the Section Collection plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Is the Section Collection free?

Yes, Section Collection is a free Gutenberg block plugin.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it will work with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse a block?

You can use unlimited times as you want.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here

items.question: What services do you offer?
items.answer: We offer a comprehensive range of services including web development, cloud solutions, digital marketing, and technical support. Our team of experts is dedicated to providing high-quality solutions tailored to your specific needs.

items.question: How can I contact customer support?
items.answer: You can reach our customer support team through multiple channels: email at support@example.com, phone at +1 (555) 123-4567, or through our live chat feature available 24/7 on our website.

items.question: How do I create an account?
items.answer: Creating an account is simple! Click the "Sign Up" button in the top right corner, fill in your details, verify your email address, and you're ready to go. The entire process takes less than 2 minutes.

items.question: How can I reset my password?
items.answer: To reset your password, click on the "Forgot Password" link on the login page. Enter your email address, and we'll send you a password reset link. Follow the instructions in the email to create a new password.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and bank transfers. For enterprise customers, we also offer custom payment terms and invoicing options.

items.question: How do I update my billing information?
items.answer: You can update your billing information by logging into your account, navigating to the "Billing" section, and clicking on "Update Payment Method". Here you can add, remove, or modify your payment details.

items.question: What are your system requirements?
items.answer: Our platform is designed to work on all modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and devices. We recommend using the latest version of your preferred browser for the best experience.

items.question: How do I integrate your API?
items.answer: We provide comprehensive API documentation and SDKs for various programming languages. You can find detailed integration guides, code examples, and API references in our Developer Portal.
